dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no! Nam, I can't find my bag!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈkænt ˈfaɪnd maɪ ˈbæɡ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Your bag? Is it at the restaurant?
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈbæɡ? ɪz ɪt ət ðə ˈrɛstərɑːnt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No! My phone is in it. Call the police!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ! maɪ ˈfoʊn ɪz ˈɪn ɪt. ˈkɔːl ðə pəˈliːs!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. The police station is near here.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ðə pəˈliːs ˌsteɪʃən ɪz ˈnɪr ˈhɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's next to the bank. Come with me!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈnɛkst tə ðə ˈbæŋk. ˈkʌm wɪð ˈmiː!
